notes.title: Lost Hope: Prologue - Update 09.11
notes.notes:
The [b]Lost Hope: Prologue[/b] "Interim" update from September 11 is aimed at improving the gameplay with the existing story part. List of the main changes:
[list]
[*] [b]Size[/b]. The overall size of the game has been significantly reduced ([b]7.02 GB[/b] → [b]3.83 GB[/b]).
[*] [b]Optimization[/b]. The amount of RAM used has been reduced by [b]15%[/b], which has a positive effect on the gameplay.
[*] [b]Appearance[/b]. The game has acquired even more realistic and pleasant graphics, which will allow you to immerse yourself in the atmosphere even more!
[*] [b]Other[/b]. Among other things, the system of player interaction with the environment has also undergone changes, due to which the game cycle has acquired an additional cinematic quality!
[/list]

notes.title: Lost Hope: Prologue Update July 19th
notes.notes:
The new version of [b]Lost Hope: Prologue[/b] has undergone a large number of changes in all the most important aspects of the game. List of main changes made:
[list]
[*] [b]Size.[/b] The overall size of the game has been reduced (7.74 GB → 7.02 GB).
[*] [b]Optimization.[/b] The same test devices show better results in the new version of the game.
[*] [b]Appearance.[/b] The game graphics have undergone a large number of positive changes. Meet completely updated game graphics!
[*] [b]Bugs.[/b] Among other things, some game elements that could have a negative impact on the gameplay have been radically changed to make the gameplay as comfortable as possible.
[/list]
